recommendations.issue: High pricing and poor perceived value
recommendations.action: Review menu pricing against portion sizes and competitor benchmarks; introduce value-focused bundles or adjust portion specs to match price points.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value and reduced pricing complaints.

recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and unprofessional service
recommendations.action: Implement a mandatory customer service training program, establish clear behavioral standards, and institute daily shift huddles to boost morale and alignment.
recommendations.expected_impact: More professional staff interactions, higher customer satisfaction scores, and reduced friction.

recommendations.action: Standardize all kitchen recipes with detailed plating guides, and institute quality control checks by the head chef before dishes leave the pass.
recommendations.expected_impact: Consistent culinary execution and elimination of substandard dishes reaching guests.

recommendations.issue: Slow service and long wait times
recommendations.action: Audit kitchen and front-of-house workflow to identify bottlenecks, and optimize staffing schedules to ensure adequate coverage during peak rush hours.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster table turn times, reduced wait durations, and improved guest flow.
